record.issue_text: Subject template accesses attendees[0].name which throws if the attendees array is empty

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the email subject interpolates `name: this.calEvent.attendees[0].name`. If `this.calEvent.attendees` is an empty array, this will throw at runtime when building the nodemailer payload. The diff does not guarantee `attendees` is non-empty (it is sourced from DB via `bookingAttendees.attendees` in `addGuests.handler.ts`).
